title: Lev Growth Agent
subtitle: Find, research and invite independent businesses — the agent prepares, you decide.

not_configured.title: The Growth Agent is not switched on
not_configured.body: It needs a place to keep its records (GROWTH_STATE_DIR on the server). Until then nothing is stored and nothing is shown.

not_signed_in.title: Sign in first
not_signed_in.body: The Growth Agent is for the platform team. Sign in with your account.

not_operator.title: This area is for the platform team
not_operator.body: Only members of the platform's own rikma operate the Growth Agent.

check_failed.title: We could not check your access
check_failed.body: The check did not get an answer. Try again in a minute.

overview.allClear: Nothing is waiting for you right now.
overview.empty: No businesses in the pipeline yet.
overview.funnelRule: Each business counts at every step it reached, even if it later declined. The percentage is the share of the previous step.

next.draftOutreach: Approved profiles without an approved invitation: {{count}}.
next.sendInvitations: Approved invitations ready for you to send: {{count}}.
next.interestedNotJoined: Expressed interest but haven't completed onboarding: {{count}}.
next.newInCategoryRegion: New {{category}} businesses discovered in {{region}} this week: {{count}}.
next.activate: Joined — check whether they are active providers: {{count}}.

discover.addBody: Record a business you found. Write only what you saw, and say where you saw it.
discover.autoBody: Searching sources automatically is the next phase. When it arrives, every result will carry its source and pass the same duplicate check:

sources.places: Google Maps / Places — when an API key is configured
sources.directories: Public business directories, under their terms
sources.social: Public social pages, only where their terms permit

discover.rules: Never invent a business or a contact detail. Never collect private data. Respect each source's terms and the outreach laws that apply.

form.name: Business name
form.sourceRule: The source is recorded next to every detail you enter.

csv.title: Import from CSV
csv.body: Up to {{max}} rows. A header row is required; columns are matched by name (Hebrew, English or Arabic). Duplicates are skipped and listed.
csv.tooMany: Only the first {{max}} rows will be read.

viewHint.research: Not researched yet, or the last research failed.
viewHint.profiles: Researched, with a profile to prepare or approve.
viewHint.outreach: Approved profiles whose invitation has not been sent.
viewHint.closed: Declined or asked not to be contacted. No outreach is possible.

research.title: Business intelligence
research.empty: No research yet. The agent reads the business's own public website and reports what it found, with evidence for every claim.
research.contacts: Contact details found on the site
research.contactsRule: Found on the page by pattern, not by the AI. Use one only if it is the business's public contact.
research.aiAnswers: The agent's suggestions — interpretation, not facts
research.requests: Which customer requests could it fulfil?
research.collaboration: Could it collaborate with other providers?

problem.site: The website could not be read
problem.model: The AI step did not run

origin.verifiedHint: From the operator's record or evidence found on the business's page
origin.suggestedHint: Proposed by the agent — check before approving
origin.aiHint: Written by the agent — read before approving

profile.title: Proposed 1💗1 profile
profile.emptyResearched: Draft the profile from the research.
profile.emptyNoResearch: You can draft a profile from the record alone, but research first gives the owner a better start.
profile.regenerateConfirm: Drafting again replaces the current profile, including your edits. Continue?
profile.approveRule: Approving means you stand behind this draft as the one to show the owner. Nothing is published: only the owner can publish it.
profile.editRule: Any change withdraws an earlier approval.
profile.preview: Preview — how the owner will first see it
profile.previewRule: The owner reviews, corrects and decides. Without their authorisation nothing appears on 1💗1.

outreach.title: Outreach and onboarding
outreach.needsProfile: Approve the profile before approving an invitation.
outreach.subject: Subject
outreach.linkHint: {{token}} is replaced with the owner's review link.

closed.doNotContact: This business asked not to be contacted

outreach.closedBody: No messages, links or follow-ups. To reopen, change the stage and state why.

onboarding.title: The owner's review link
onboarding.body: Prepares the profile as a draft the owner can review, correct, and then create — or not. Requires an approved profile and the business's public email.
onboarding.hasAccount: This email already has a 1💗1 account: the link hands the draft to that account.

send.title: Send — from your own app
send.rule: Opening WhatsApp or an email draft does not send anything, and does not tell us it was delivered or read.
send.noLink: No review link yet — the message will go without one.

response.title: Record their response
response.question: Asked a question
response.dncConfirm: This closes outreach for this business and erases its email and phone. Its identity is kept only so it is never imported again. Continue?

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.rule: A reminder for you. Nothing is sent automatically.

intel.noGaps: No gaps stand out in the data yet.
intel.wanted: {{category}}: named as a needed partner by {{count}} joined providers, and none is active.
intel.rule: From the pipeline's own records. Customer demand from the concierge will join these signals in the next phase.
intel.metricRule: Success is useful coverage by active providers and real customer matches — not the number of registrations.

settings.operators: Operators: members of rikma #{{project}} (optionally narrowed by GROWTH_OPERATOR_IDS).
settings.storage: Records: GROWTH_STATE_DIR on the server, one file, never in the browser.
settings.model: AI: the platform's model chain, called from the server only. Without a model, standard templates are used.
settings.env: These settings live in the server's environment, not on this page.

rule.noInvent: Never invents a business, a fact or a contact detail.
rule.sources: Records the source of every fact; verified and suggested are always marked.
rule.noAutoSend: Sends nothing. Every message is approved and sent by a person.
rule.consent: Never accepts, signs or publishes on a business owner's behalf.
rule.dnc: Never contacts a business that declined or asked not to be contacted.
rule.privacy: Reads only public business pages; never private data.
rule.terms: Skips sources whose terms forbid automated reading (social networks).

settings.dncBody: These businesses keep only a hashed identity, so a future import will recognise and skip them.

errors.BAD_EMAIL: That email address doesn't look right.
errors.BAD_PHONE: That phone number doesn't look right.
errors.BAD_WEBSITE: The website must be an http(s) address.
errors.BAD_SOURCE_URL: The source link must be an http(s) address.
errors.DUPLICATE: This business is already in the pipeline.
errors.CLOSED_DOOR: This business declined or asked not to be contacted.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Say why you are reopening a business that asked not to be contacted.
errors.SAME_STAGE: It is already at that stage.
errors.EMAIL_REQUIRED: Add the business's public email first.
errors.BAD_DATE: Choose a date within the next year.
errors.BAD_FIELD: One of the fields is not valid.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (1 MB at most).
errors.NO_NAME_COLUMN: No name column was found in the header row.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many links prepared — try again later.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: The Growth Agent is not configured on the server.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This business is no longer in the pipeline.
errors.self: That is your own email — the link is for the business owner.
errors.unverified: We could not confirm this email right now. Try again.
